title: fix(tests): prevent stale bytecode from hiding failures
body:
## Summary

Stale timestamp or unchecked-hash bytecode can make isolated unittest discovery pass while the current helper source fails its numeric check. Give every ordinary unittest child and historical wrapper a private cache namespace under the existing receipt directory.

```diff
 unittest / historical wrapper
- inherit the default bytecode-cache lookup
+ -B -X pycache_prefix=<owned private namespace>
```

Retain discovery arguments, sorted output, completion receipts, scheduling and process ownership. Admit the new runner digest in the historical adapter while retaining its frozen original. The source-bound differential retrieves the exact baseline rather than copying a predecessor package.

## Evidence

- **Before:** pinned baseline `b3f3ee0392b71b118fd086a6eaf6b4cab54ef455` reports success with cached `VALUE=2`, current source `VALUE=1`, expected 2. Removing only the cache exposes `AssertionError: 1 != 2`.
  **After:** the same current source fails with or without either stale cache; clean current value 2 passes. Source/cache bytes remain unchanged.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay passes, including seven new CLI regression groups. The groups and differential also pass under optimized CPython 3.14.8 with warnings treated as errors.
- Existing isolated/historical suites: 51 passed, 13 preexisting platform skips on macOS. Selected-source and CI input/trigger guards pass. Separate internal review found no actionable issue; committed-byte preflight passes.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/isolated-test-bytecode`.

[Canonical investigation and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2988). Credit [PR2553](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2553), the retained frame-closure child-isolation result and existing runner contributors. Original pins remain immutable; refreshed main `836b19bfa309ceafbc8ee32a15e8c4b10dde7e11` advances guidance to revision 6 without changing this card or its runtime inputs.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** test-runner

Fresh imports can increase startup cost. Arbitrary Python descendants started by tests, custom loaders and concurrent source mutation remain outside scope. Native lifetime checks skipped on macOS need their supported platforms. No complete selected cold replay, scientific supplier admission, new kappa or frontier change is claimed.
